results.method: Independent reproduction: cache files read directly as JSONL; partition re-derived row by row from sha256(group_key) mod 10; detector re-run on the 293 final-test labelled rows; Wilson/AUROC (pairwise Mann-Whitney)/AUPRC/TPR@FPR/cluster-bootstrap recomputed from scratch with independent implementations in this script. No tuning on the final holdout.

notes: Independent reproduction of Worker C's OpAI-Bench partitioned evaluation. Every compared field either agrees exactly or is listed in 'discrepancies'. Reproduction verdict: AGREE.
